Subject: Split billing: setup for HelioHealth (US / UK / EU entities)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — HelioHealth is ready to move to a pilot but we need split invoicing set up across our entities. High level: US corporate (HelioHealth Inc.), UK subsidiary (HelioHealth Ltd, GB VAT: GB123456789), and an EU billing hub (HelioHealth EU S.à r.l., VAT: LU987654321).

Requirements from our side:
- Single monthly invoice that can be itemized and split to three remittance instructions (we need separate invoices per legal entity for accounting).
- Clear cost-center mapping per line item (we'll tag PO 4867 with seat counts).
- VAT treatment: services to UK/EU entities may be reverse-charge in some cases — we need Redwood's recommended approach.
- Preferred payment rails: bank wire for UK/EU, ACH for US.
- Pilot month: July. Can you confirm the step-by-step and what information you need from our AP team?

Thanks,
Sarah

1) Internal kickoff & MAA: we'll prepare a remittance appendix that captures entity-level tax IDs and payment rails. Kimberly — can you own the Appendix / SOW update?
2) Mapping: Camila will collect the cost-center mapping and confirm seat-level attribution for PO 4867.
3) AP template & rails: Ben will share the CSV template Helio's AP can upload to our payments workflow and confirm any bank restrictions.
4) Pilot timeline: if Helio signs the Appendix by 24 Jun, we can run a test invoice for the July billing cycle and reconcile w/ your AP in early Aug.

Please send the VAT IDs and preferred remittance bank details for each entity. I'll loop Marissa for accounting sign-off once Kimberly has the Appendix ready.

Best,
Jonas

Sarah — thanks. A few compliance points from Finance/Legal: 

- We'll include an Appendix to the MAA to capture entity remittance instructions, VAT registrations, and who bears VAT (reverse charge vs. gross).
- For EU reverse-charge treatment we need: HelioHealth EU's VAT ID (LU987654321) and a statement that the entity is the recipient of the services.
- For the UK: if the supply is to HelioHealth Ltd (GB123456789), we require the UK VAT registration and confirm whether the UK entity will self-account.
- Tax invoices: Redwood can emit three legal invoices (one per entity). The consolidated PDF will include a page-level remittance stub for each legal entity so your AP has all instructions in one package.

Attached: MAA_Helio_Remittance_Instructions.pdf — draft Appendix (please review). Once approved we will route for signature (DocuSign link will be provided).

Marissa — once Sarah confirms, please queue accounting to validate the entity-level GL mapping and expected tax codes.

Subject: Re: AP template + payment rails for HelioHealth pilot

Sarah — attaching the CSV template we use for AP automation (helio_ap_csv_template.csv). Guidance: 
- Required columns: invoice_date, invoice_number, legal_entity, remit_entity, gl_cost_center, amount_local, currency, vat_amount, vat_code, po_number, ap_contact_email.
- Accepted rails: SEPA/IBAN for EU, BACS/IBAN (GBP) for UK, ACH for US. Stripe payouts can be used where you prefer credit card/virtual account routing, but for entity-level legal invoicing we recommend straight bank wires to avoid intermediated tax treatment.
- Payment hold windows: our collector process holds funds 24–48 hours for cross-border bank verification during the pilot. If Helio's bank requires longer holds we can add a buffer to the remittance ETA.

Ben Carter
Senior Collections Manager | Redwood Inference
